title: Nuances of Necessity: kell, muszáj, kénytelen

sections.title: Modal Shades of Compulsion
sections.content: *Kell* (objective or general necessity), *muszáj* (urgent, inescapable physical or practical pressure), *kénytelen* (reluctantly forced by external circumstances: *kénytelen volt elismerni*).

items.spanish: A bizonyítékok láttán a vádlott kénytelen volt beismerni a tévedését.
items.english: In view of the evidence, the accused was forced to admit his mistake.

items.spanish: Ha el akarjuk kerülni a bírságot, most muszáj azonnal cselekednünk.
items.english: If we want to avoid the fine, we simply must act immediately right now.
